newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA AND SPAIN SIGN REPATRIATION AGREEMENT.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA AND SPAIN SIGN REPATRIATION AGREEMENT.

text.p: Bulgaria and Spain signed an agreement on Monday for repatriation of nationals living illegally in their two countries, a Bulgarian foreign ministry official said.
"Under the agreement people with unclear legal status residing in Bulgaria and Spain would be returned to their mother countries," ministry spokesman Pantalei Karasimeonov told Reuters.
The agreement was signed by Bulgaria's first deputy foreign minister Irina Bokova and the Spanish ambassador to Sofia Jorge Fuentes.

Foreign ministry officials say the signing of similar agreements is one of the main conditions for taking Bulgaria off a blacklist drawn up by European Union countries who have toughened external border controls under the Schengen agreement.
So far Bulgaria has signed repatriation agreements with Germany, Greece, France, Switzerland, Poland and Slovakia.
Some 580,000 Bulgarians, mainly young and well-educated, left their crisis-ridden country between 1989 and 1995, looking for a better life abroad, official figures show.
